purpose: The supplementary comparison adds historical specialty/calendar rules and compute-cost measurements. Supplement does not change learned candidate selection.
smoothing: 30 train prior-equivalent appointments; unknown combinations fall back to train overall prevalence
fit_boundary: Same expanding prior-years folds 2017, 2018, 2019; selected learned comparator reused unchanged; 2020 research qualification once without subsequent tuning.
probability_baselines: Per fold constant full-training prevalence and last90-training-calendar-days prevalence; historical2020 comparison only. No calibration-cohort prevalence fitted and scored on itself.
resources: Refit each prespecified model once on all development dates<2020, measured isolated-process peak RSS and fit wall time; single synthetic appointment and 1000 synthetic appointment inference, median of20 repeats. No model serialization/publication.
reporting: Show original development gate and stricter every-fold positive direction with no retroactive model selection. New baseline cannot be used to cherry-pick a learned model. No clinically justified effect-size threshold is available, so no clinically meaningful-benefit claim.
